source: ⛔ PLACEHOLDER. Read every rate off the Generate button in the UI for THIS account before using it — the published price list has measured wrong. Nothing here is a default; scripts/refresh_costs.md is the procedure.

plan._credit_price_usd: What ONE credit actually costs this account: monthly price ÷ monthly credits. ⛔ Derive it from the invoice, not from a plan table — published tiers disagree with each other and with the account. 0 = unset, and the estimator prints credits only.

_default_preset: Both quoting tools price QUALITY unless you pass --economy (the quality floor, SKILL.md §4 item 11); economy is a labelled comparison only (v2.62.0).

economy.note: Derived from rate_table on 2026-09-01. ⛔ DERIVE, do not copy: `python3 scripts/rate_card.py lookup --model <m> --res <r> --seconds <n>`. assets/higgsfield-rates.json -> rate_table is the only place a rate lives; a number typed here is a copy that will go stale silently. Image frames are priced separately (2 cr @2K, UI-measured). Generate at exactly delivery resolution.
